race.comment: INZAIN DRAGON (3) goes on top again after a close third here as a well-supported favourite on debut last time. He raced keenly early and still showed plenty of grit to get as close as he did, so natural improvement second-up gives him a strong winning profile. TURBO COW (7) was disappointing at Eagle Farm as favourite on the back of encouraging trial form. The subsequent form out of the race has been ref-hot however, so willing to forgive. THE GREY ONE (4) is the key first-starter, shouldering a neat little price tag as a son of Profiteer. Has shown improvement at the trials and any market support should be respected. MAGIC SNITZEL (10) picked up late last start at Ballina after a Coffs fourth. Fitter now and worth consideration.
